specs.max_nota: 3 minutes since January 2025 (announced by the head of Instagram, reported widely). One 2026 source claims 20 minutes: unverified.
specs.ideal_nota: Heuristic (no Instagram figure). Length is not a stated ranking factor; watch time is, so the shortest version that delivers the payoff wins.

safe_area.nota: unverified: Meta's Business Help Center has a Stories/Reels safe-zone page for ads (content not readable this session); values are a 2026 agency reading of it (top 14%, bottom 35%, sides 6%). The right action column sits inside the bottom-right; keep text left of x=900 in the lower half too.

caption_limit.nota: Hashtags capped at 5 per post/Reel since December 2025 (news coverage; whether comments count is disputed). 2200 characters: unverified this session (long-standing figure).

specs.cover: Choose a frame or upload a cover; the profile grid crops Reels toward 3:4 (unverified exact ratio), so keep cover text in the centre 1080x1440 band.

algoritmo: Instagram's ranking explainer: Reels ranking predicts how likely you are to reshare, watch all the way through, like, or visit the audio page. Inputs in rough order: your activity, your history with the poster, information about the reel (audio, visuals, popularity), information about the poster.

The three signals the head of Instagram named in January 2025: watch time, likes per reach, sends per reach (DM shares). Sends weigh most for reaching non-followers (secondary sources; exact wording not seen on a primary page).
Made less visible: low-resolution or watermarked reels, muted reels, reels with borders, reels that are mostly text, and reels already posted on Instagram.

Originality: since 2024 Instagram swaps reposts for the original in recommendations and penalises aggregators; in 2026 this extended to photos/carousels, with accounts judged over a month (press coverage).
Trial reels (December 2024): show a reel to non-followers first; insights in 24 h; can be shared to followers after if it performs.
estrategia: Optimise for sends: content people want to show one friend ('you need to see this detail'). End with a line that invites the send, not the like.
Do not let the reel be 'mostly text': the presenter, the artwork in motion and voice carry it; text is support.
Use trial reels to test two hooks for the same episode with non-followers before committing.
Carousel companion: the same episode as a 5-8 slide carousel (artwork, detail crops, source) for saves.
Post the native master without TikTok/CapCut watermarks.
cta: Send prompt: 'Send this to the friend who walks past this painting.'
Two-option question in the caption and on screen; avoid 'comment X to get Y' bait on Meta surfaces.

hashtags_seo.caption: First line = hook + keyword (visible before 'more'); then 1-2 sentences with names and places; up to 5 hashtags (hard cap).
hashtags_seo.busqueda: Instagram search reads captions, alt text and on-screen text (secondary sources, unverified). Write a manual alt text describing the artwork.

musica: Main music library licensed for personal, non-commercial use; certain business accounts are limited to the Meta Sound Collection (cleared for commercial use). Instagram's licenses do not travel: a file exported with Instagram audio is not cleared for TikTok or YouTube. Muted reels are made less visible, so always ship with audio. For this pipeline: own/generated music, voice always present.

ia_disclosure.obligatorio: Meta requires people to disclose organic posts with photorealistic video or realistic-sounding audio that was digitally created or altered (policy since 2024; secondary sources for the exact scope). Still images are not required but may be auto-labeled.
ia_disclosure.como: Use the 'AI info' / AI label toggle when posting (mobile app). Meta also labels automatically when it detects industry-standard AI signals (C2PA/IPTC). Content only edited with AI shows the label in the post menu; AI-generated content shows it directly (September 2024 update).
ia_disclosure.consecuencias: Meta 'may apply penalties' for not disclosing (not specified publicly); high-risk deceptive content may get a more prominent label; fact-checked 'Altered' content is shown lower.
ia_disclosure.para_esta_app: Photoreal presenter + synthetic voice: always toggle the AI label on Instagram and Facebook.

publicacion.cadencia: No universal number (head of Instagram: some creators succeed posting once a month, others five reels a day). Instagram's creator FAQ is reported to say the fastest-growing creators post 10+ reels per month (secondary, unverified): ~3 per week for a series.
publicacion.horas: Use Professional dashboard > Insights > 'Most active times'; Instagram's Best Practices hub gives per-account frequency guidance.

adaptar_desde_master: Keep 9:16 1080x1920, no other app's watermark, no borders or letterbox.
Move subtitles and key text above y=1250 and inside x 65-1015; the bottom 35% holds caption, audio and actions (collage style y_subtitulos=1400 is inside it).
Cut to the tightest version that keeps the payoff (watch time is the signal); 3-minute cap.
Replace the CTA with a send prompt.
Caption: hook line + keywords + up to 5 hashtags; alt text.
Toggle the AI label; check music is cleared for the account type.
